knowledge:
- key_parameters: filter_zeros=Logical value to enable/disable filtering of zero-count exon bins (set to FALSE for microarray data) ;; filter_low_counts=Logical value to enable/disable filtering of low-count exons (set to FALSE for microarray data) ;; normalize=Logical value to enable/disable calculation of normalization factors (set to FALSE for microarray data) ;; voom=Logical value to enable/disable limma-voom transformation and weights (set to FALSE for microarray data) ;; seed=Integer value used to set the random seed for reproducible model fitting ;; rank_by=Character string specifying whether to rank results by "FDR" or raw p-values in summaryTable() ;; n=Number of top genes to display in summaryTable() (set to Inf to show all) ;; threshold=Significance threshold for summaryTable() (set to 1 to show all genes) ;; when_null_selected=Character string ("ones", "full", or "NA") determining how to handle genes where the lasso model selects zero interaction terms ;; alpha=Elastic net parameter for glmnet (between 0 for ridge and 1 for lasso, default is 1) ;; lambda_choice=Parameter to select optimal lambda from cv.glmnet ("lambda.min" or "lambda.1se", default is "lambda.min")
- alternatives: DEXSeq is mentioned as a standard approach, specifically for generating exon bin counts using its Python scripts. regsplice is preferred when faster runtimes and improved power via regularization are desired.
- when_to_use: Appropriate for detecting differential exon usage (differential splicing) across two or more experimental conditions using either RNA-seq read counts or log2-transformed exon microarray intensities.
- pitfalls: For exon microarray data, users must log2-transform intensities externally and disable filtering, normalization, and voom steps (filter_zeros = FALSE, filter_low_counts = FALSE, normalize = FALSE, voom = FALSE). For RNA-seq data, voom assumes zero and low-count exons have already been filtered, so filterZeros() and filterLowCounts() must be executed before runVoom(). If a lasso model selects zero interaction terms, the LR test cannot be calculated; users must configure when_null_selected (default "ones" is usually sufficient, but "full" is required to rank low-evidence genes).

workflows.name: rna_seq_wrapper
workflows.intent: Run the complete regsplice analysis pipeline on RNA-seq count data in a single step using the wrapper function.
input: counts (matrix or data frame of RNA-seq read counts)
n_exons (vector of number of exon bins per gene)
workflows.stages: 1. Create RegspliceData object ;; 2. Run the wrapper analysis pipeline ;; 3. Generate a summary table of results
workflows.code:
file_counts <- system.file("extdata/vignette_counts.txt", package = "regsplice")
data <- read.table(file_counts, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

counts <- data[, 2:7]
tbl_exons <- table(sapply(strsplit(data$exon, ":"), function(s) s[[1]]))
gene_IDs <- names(tbl_exons)
n_exons <- unname(tbl_exons)

condition <- rep(c("untreated", "treated"), each = 3)

library(regsplice)

rs_data <- RegspliceData(counts, gene_IDs, n_exons, condition)

rs_results <- suppressWarnings(regsplice(rs_data, seed = 123))

summaryTable(rs_results)

workflows.name: rna_seq_step_by_step
workflows.intent: Run the regsplice analysis pipeline step-by-step on RNA-seq count data for maximum flexibility and control over filtering, normalization, and model fitting.
input: counts (matrix or data frame of RNA-seq read counts)
n_exons (vector of number of exon bins per gene)
workflows.stages: 1. Create RegspliceData object ;; 2. Filter zero-count exon bins ;; 3. Filter low-count exons ;; 4. Calculate normalization factors ;; 5. Apply voom transformation and weights ;; 6. Initialize RegspliceResults object ;; 7. Fit regularized, null, and full models ;; 8. Calculate likelihood ratio tests ;; 9. Generate summary table of results
workflows.code:
file_counts <- system.file("extdata/vignette_counts.txt", package = "regsplice")
data <- read.table(file_counts, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

counts <- data[, 2:7]
tbl_exons <- table(sapply(strsplit(data$exon, ":"), function(s) s[[1]]))
gene_IDs <- names(tbl_exons)
n_exons <- unname(tbl_exons)

condition <- rep(c("untreated", "treated"), each = 3)

library(regsplice)

rs_data <- RegspliceData(counts, gene_IDs, n_exons, condition)

rs_data <- filterZeros(rs_data)

rs_data <- filterLowCounts(rs_data)

rs_data <- runNormalization(rs_data)

rs_data <- runVoom(rs_data)

colData(rs_data)

rs_results <- initializeResults(rs_data)

seed <- 123

rs_results <- suppressWarnings(fitRegMultiple(rs_results, rs_data, seed = seed))

rs_results <- fitNullMultiple(rs_results, rs_data, seed = seed)

rs_results <- fitFullMultiple(rs_results, rs_data, seed = seed)

rs_results <- LRTests(rs_results)

summaryTable(rs_results)
